WITH daily_toy_sales AS (
    SELECT
        SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 0, 10) AS sale_date,
        SUM(oi.price) AS daily_sales
    FROM `E_commerce`.`E_commerce_scope`.`orders` AS o
    JOIN `E_commerce`.`E_commerce_scope`.`order_items` AS oi
        ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN `E_commerce`.`E_commerce_scope`.`products` AS p
        ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_category_name = "brinquedos"
      AND SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 0, 10) BETWEEN "2017-01-01" AND "2018-08-29"
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 0, 10)
),
regression_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(1) AS n,
        SUM(DATE_DIFF_STR(sale_date, "2017-01-01", "day")) AS sum_x,
        SUM(daily_sales) AS sum_y,
        SUM(DATE_DIFF_STR(sale_date, "2017-01-01", "day") * daily_sales) AS sum_xy,
        SUM(DATE_DIFF_STR(sale_date, "2017-01-01", "day") * DATE_DIFF_STR(sale_date, "2017-01-01", "day")) AS sum_x2
    FROM daily_toy_sales
),
model AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN (n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x)
        END AS slope,
        CASE
            WHEN n = 0 OR (n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (sum_y - ((n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x)) * sum_x) / n
        END AS intercept
    FROM regression_stats
),
prediction_days AS (
    SELECT "2018-12-03" AS target_date
    UNION ALL SELECT "2018-12-04" AS target_date
    UNION ALL SELECT "2018-12-05" AS target_date
    UNION ALL SELECT "2018-12-06" AS target_date
    UNION ALL SELECT "2018-12-07" AS target_date
    UNION ALL SELECT "2018-12-08" AS target_date
    UNION ALL SELECT "2018-12-09" AS target_date
    UNION ALL SELECT "2018-12-10" AS target_date
),
predicted_sales AS (
    SELECT
        pd.target_date,
        m.slope * DATE_DIFF_STR(pd.target_date, "2017-01-01", "day") + m.intercept AS predicted_daily_sales
    FROM prediction_days AS pd
    CROSS JOIN model AS m
),
moving_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p1.target_date,
        AVG(p2.predicted_daily_sales) AS moving_avg_5day
    FROM predicted_sales AS p1
    JOIN predicted_sales AS p2
        ON DATE_DIFF_STR(p2.target_date, p1.target_date, "day") BETWEEN -2 AND 2
    WHERE p1.target_date BETWEEN "2018-12-05" AND "2018-12-08"
    GROUP BY p1.target_date
)
SELECT
    SUM(moving_avg_5day) AS sum_of_5day_symmetric_moving_averages
FROM moving_averages;

query:
WITH order_payment_totals AS (
    SELECT
        op.order_id,
        SUM(op.payment_value) AS order_value
    FROM `E_commerce`.`E_commerce_scope`.`order_payments` AS op
    GROUP BY op.order_id
),
delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        COALESCE(opt.order_value, 0) AS order_value
    FROM `E_commerce`.`E_commerce_scope`.`orders` AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_payment_totals AS opt
        ON o.order_id = opt.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = "delivered"
),
max_purchase AS (
    SELECT MAX(d.order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_purchase_ts
    FROM delivered_orders AS d
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_unique_id,
        DATE_DIFF_STR(mp.max_purchase_ts, MAX(d.order_purchase_timestamp), "day") AS recency_days,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) AS frequency,
        SUM(d.order_value) AS monetary,
        SUM(d.order_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) AS avg_sales_per_order
    FROM delivered_orders AS d
    JOIN `E_commerce`.`E_commerce_scope`.`customers` AS c
        ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN max_purchase AS mp
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id, mp.max_purchase_ts
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        cm.customer_unique_id,
        cm.recency_days,
        cm.frequency,
        cm.monetary,
        cm.avg_sales_per_order,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY cm.recency_days ASC) AS r_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY cm.frequency DESC) AS f_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY cm.monetary DESC) AS m_score
    FROM customer_metrics AS cm
),
segmented AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_unique_id,
        s.recency_days,
        s.frequency,
        s.monetary,
        s.avg_sales_per_order,
        s.r_score,
        s.f_score,
        s.m_score,
        CASE
            WHEN s.r_score = 1 AND (s.f_score + s.m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN "Champions"
            WHEN s.r_score IN [4, 5] AND (s.f_score + s.m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN "Can't Lose Them"
            WHEN s.r_score IN [4, 5] AND (s.f_score + s.m_score) BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN "Hibernating"
            WHEN s.r_score IN [4, 5] AND (s.f_score + s.m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN "Lost"
            WHEN s.r_score IN [2, 3] AND (s.f_score + s.m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN "Loyal Customers"
            WHEN s.r_score = 3 AND (s.f_score + s.m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN "Needs Attention"
            WHEN s.r_score = 1 AND (s.f_score + s.m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN "Recent Users"
            WHEN (s.r_score = 1 AND (s.f_score + s.m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
                 OR (s.r_score = 2 AND (s.f_score + s.m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN "Potential Loyalists"
            WHEN s.r_score = 1 AND (s.f_score + s.m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN "Price Sensitive"
            WHEN s.r_score = 2 AND (s.f_score + s.m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN "Promising"
            WHEN s.r_score = 3 AND (s.f_score + s.m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN "About to Sleep"
            ELSE "Unclassified"
        END AS rfm_segment
    FROM scored AS s
)
SELECT
    rfm_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_sales_per_order), 2) AS segment_avg_sales_per_order,
    ROUND(MIN(avg_sales_per_order), 2) AS min_customer_avg_sales_per_order,
    ROUND(MAX(avg_sales_per_order), 2) AS max_customer_avg_sales_per_order,
    ROUND(AVG(recency_days), 2) AS avg_recency_days,
    ROUND(AVG(frequency), 2) AS avg_frequency,
    ROUND(AVG(monetary), 2) AS avg_monetary
FROM segmented
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY segment_avg_sales_per_order DESC;

SELECT
  o.customer_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS number_of_orders,
  AVG(op.order_payment_total) AS average_payment_per_order,
  CASE
    WHEN DATE_DIFF_STR(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp), MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp), "day") < 7 THEN 1.0
    ELSE DATE_DIFF_STR(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp), MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp), "day") / 7.0
  END AS customer_lifespan_weeks
FROM `E_commerce`.`E_commerce_scope`.`orders` AS o
JOIN (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    SUM(payment_value) AS order_payment_total
  FROM `E_commerce`.`E_commerce_scope`.`order_payments`
  GROUP BY order_id
) AS op
  ON o.order_id = op.order_id
GROUP BY o.customer_id
ORDER BY average_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3;

    SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + CASE WHEN er.extra_type NOT IN ["byes", "legbyes"] THEN COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS runs_conceded,

        ) AS prev_city,

            ORDER BY g.geolocation_state, g.geolocation_city, g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix, g.geolocation_lat, g.geolocation_lng
        ) AS prev_zip_code_prefix,

    FROM `Brazilian_E_Commerce`.`Brazilian_E_Commerce_scope`.`olist_order_payments` AS op

    WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL

    GROUP BY p.product_category_name, op.payment_type
),
category_top_payment AS (
    SELECT
        cpc.product_category_name,
        cpc.payment_type,
        cpc.payment_count

        FROM category_payment_counts AS cpc2
        WHERE cpc2.product_category_name = cpc.product_category_name
    )[0]
)
SELECT
    product_category_name,
    payment_type AS most_common_payment_type,
    payment_count
FROM category_top_payment
ORDER BY payment_count DESC, product_category_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH historical_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_month_number AS month_num,
        t.calendar_year AS year_num,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_sales
    FROM `complex_oracle`.`complex_oracle_scope`.`sales` AS s
    JOIN `complex_oracle`.`complex_oracle_scope`.`customers` AS cu
        ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN `complex_oracle`.`complex_oracle_scope`.`countries` AS co
        ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN `complex_oracle`.`complex_oracle_scope`.`promotions` AS p
        ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id
    JOIN `complex_oracle`.`complex_oracle_scope`.`channels` AS ch
        ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
    JOIN `complex_oracle`.`complex_oracle_scope`.`times` AS t
        ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = "France"
      AND t.calendar_year IN [2019, 2020]
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
),
avg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        hs.prod_id,
        hs.month_num,
        AVG(hs.total_sales) AS avg_sales
    FROM historical_sales AS hs
    GROUP BY hs.prod_id, hs.month_num
),
sales_2019 AS (
    SELECT
        hs.prod_id,
        hs.month_num,
        hs.total_sales AS sales_2019
    FROM historical_sales AS hs
    WHERE hs.year_num = 2019
),
sales_2020 AS (
    SELECT
        hs.prod_id,
        hs.month_num,
        hs.total_sales AS sales_2020
    FROM historical_sales AS hs
    WHERE hs.year_num = 2020
),
product_months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        hs.prod_id,
        hs.month_num
    FROM historical_sales AS hs
),
projected_sales AS (
    SELECT
        pm.prod_id,
        pm.month_num,
        CASE
            WHEN s19.sales_2019 IS NOT NULL
                 AND s19.sales_2019 != 0
                 AND s20.sales_2020 IS NOT NULL
            THEN (((s20.sales_2020 - s19.sales_2019) / s19.sales_2019) * s20.sales_2020) + s20.sales_2020
            ELSE a.avg_sales
        END AS projected_sales_2021
    FROM product_months AS pm
    LEFT JOIN sales_2019 AS s19
        ON pm.prod_id = s19.prod_id
       AND pm.month_num = s19.month_num
    LEFT JOIN sales_2020 AS s20
        ON pm.prod_id = s20.prod_id
       AND pm.month_num = s20.month_num
    LEFT JOIN avg_sales AS a
        ON pm.prod_id = a.prod_id
       AND pm.month_num = a.month_num
),
monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ps.month_num,
        ROUND(AVG(ps.projected_sales_2021 * COALESCE(cur.to_us, 1)), 2) AS avg_monthly_projected_sales_usd
    FROM projected_sales AS ps
    LEFT JOIN `complex_oracle`.`complex_oracle_scope`.`currency` AS cur
        ON cur.country = "France"
       AND cur.year = 2021
       AND cur.month = ps.month_num
    GROUP BY ps.month_num
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(vals) = 0 THEN NULL
        WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(vals) % 2 = 1
            THEN vals[FLOOR(ARRAY_LENGTH(vals) / 2)]
        ELSE ROUND((vals[FLOOR(ARRAY_LENGTH(vals) / 2) - 1] + vals[FLOOR(ARRAY_LENGTH(vals) / 2)]) / 2, 2)
    END AS median_avg_monthly_projected_sales_usd
FROM (
    SELECT (
        SELECT RAW m.avg_monthly_projected_sales_usd
        FROM monthly_avg AS m
        ORDER BY m.avg_monthly_projected_sales_usd
    ) AS vals
) AS x;

WITH artist_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ar.ArtistId,
        ar.Name AS ArtistName,
        SUM(ii.Quantity * ii.UnitPrice) AS TotalSales
    FROM `chinook`.`chinook_scope`.`artists` AS ar
    JOIN `chinook`.`chinook_scope`.`albums` AS al
        ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
    JOIN `chinook`.`chinook_scope`.`tracks` AS t
        ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
    JOIN `chinook`.`chinook_scope`.`invoice_items` AS ii
        ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
    GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
),
top_artist AS (
    SELECT as1.ArtistId, as1.ArtistName, as1.TotalSales
    FROM artist_sales AS as1
    ORDER BY as1.TotalSales DESC, as1.ArtistName ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
bottom_artist AS (
    SELECT as2.ArtistId, as2.ArtistName, as2.TotalSales
    FROM artist_sales AS as2
    ORDER BY as2.TotalSales ASC, as2.ArtistName ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
customer_artist_spend AS (
    SELECT
        i.CustomerId,
        ar.ArtistId,
        SUM(ii.Quantity * ii.UnitPrice) AS CustomerSpend
    FROM `chinook`.`chinook_scope`.`invoices` AS i
    JOIN `chinook`.`chinook_scope`.`invoice_items` AS ii
        ON ii.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    JOIN `chinook`.`chinook_scope`.`tracks` AS t
        ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
    JOIN `chinook`.`chinook_scope`.`albums` AS al
        ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
    JOIN `chinook`.`chinook_scope`.`artists` AS ar
        ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
    GROUP BY i.CustomerId, ar.ArtistId
),
top_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(cas.CustomerSpend) AS AvgSpendTop
    FROM customer_artist_spend AS cas
    JOIN top_artist AS ta
        ON cas.ArtistId = ta.ArtistId
),
bottom_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(cas.CustomerSpend) AS AvgSpendBottom
    FROM customer_artist_spend AS cas
    JOIN bottom_artist AS ba
        ON cas.ArtistId = ba.ArtistId
)
SELECT ABS(ta.AvgSpendTop - ba.AvgSpendBottom) AS AbsoluteDifference
FROM top_avg AS ta
CROSS JOIN bottom_avg AS ba;

WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT
        p.customer_id,
        SUBSTR(p.payment_date, 0, 7) AS payment_month,
        SUM(p.amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM `sqlite-sakila`.`sqlite_sakila_scope`.`payment` AS p
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, SUBSTR(p.payment_date, 0, 7)
),
monthly_changes AS (
    SELECT
        mt.customer_id,
        mt.payment_month,
        mt.monthly_total,
        LAG(mt.monthly_total) OVER (
            PARTITION BY mt.customer_id
            ORDER BY mt.payment_month
        ) AS prev_month_total
    FROM monthly_totals AS mt
),
avg_changes AS (
    SELECT
        mc.customer_id,
        AVG(ABS(mc.monthly_total - mc.prev_month_total)) AS avg_monthly_change
    FROM monthly_changes AS mc
    WHERE mc.prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY mc.customer_id
)
SELECT
    c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS full_name
FROM avg_changes AS ac
JOIN `sqlite-sakila`.`sqlite_sakila_scope`.`customer` AS c
    ON ac.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY ac.avg_monthly_change DESC

WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_month_number AS month_num,
        t.calendar_month_name AS month_name,
        t.calendar_year AS sales_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_sales
    FROM `complex_oracle`.`complex_oracle_scope`.`sales` AS s
    JOIN `complex_oracle`.`complex_oracle_scope`.`customers` AS cu
        ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN `complex_oracle`.`complex_oracle_scope`.`countries` AS co
        ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN `complex_oracle`.`complex_oracle_scope`.`times` AS t
        ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN `complex_oracle`.`complex_oracle_scope`.`promotions` AS p
        ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id
    JOIN `complex_oracle`.`complex_oracle_scope`.`channels` AS ch
        ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
    WHERE co.country_name = "France"
      AND t.calendar_year IN [2019, 2020]
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_month_name, t.calendar_year
),
sales_2019 AS (
    SELECT
        prod_id,
        month_num,
        month_name,
        total_sales AS sales_2019
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE sales_year = 2019
),
sales_2020 AS (
    SELECT
        prod_id,
        month_num,
        month_name,
        total_sales AS sales_2020
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE sales_year = 2020
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT
        s20.prod_id,
        s20.month_num,
        s20.month_name,
        CASE
            WHEN s19.sales_2019 IS NOT NULL
                 AND s19.sales_2019 != 0
                 AND s20.sales_2020 IS NOT NULL
            THEN (((s20.sales_2020 - s19.sales_2019) / s19.sales_2019) * s20.sales_2020) + s20.sales_2020
            ELSE NULL
        END AS projected_sales
    FROM sales_2020 AS s20
    JOIN sales_2019 AS s19
        ON s20.prod_id = s19.prod_id
       AND s20.month_num = s19.month_num
),
projected_usd AS (
    SELECT
        p.month_num,
        p.month_name,
        p.prod_id,
        p.projected_sales * COALESCE(cu.to_us, 1) AS projected_sales_usd
    FROM projected_2021 AS p
    LEFT JOIN `complex_oracle`.`complex_oracle_scope`.`currency` AS cu
        ON cu.country = "France"
       AND cu.year = 2021
       AND cu.month = p.month_num
    WHERE p.projected_sales IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    month_num,
    month_name,
    ROUND(AVG(projected_sales_usd), 2) AS avg_projected_monthly_sales_usd
FROM projected_usd
GROUP BY month_num, month_name
ORDER BY month_num;

WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.order_id, c.pizza_id, c.exclusions, c.extras
  FROM `modern_data`.`modern_data_scope`.`pizza_clean_customer_orders` AS c
  JOIN `modern_data`.`modern_data_scope`.`pizza_clean_runner_orders` AS r
    ON c.order_id = r.order_id
  WHERE r.cancellation IS NULL
),
base_ingredients AS (
  SELECT TONUMBER(TRIM(topping_id)) AS topping_id
  FROM delivered_orders AS d
  JOIN `modern_data`.`modern_data_scope`.`pizza_recipes` AS pr
    ON d.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
  UNNEST SPLIT(pr.toppings, ",") AS topping_id
  WHERE d.exclusions IS NULL
     OR TONUMBER(TRIM(topping_id)) NOT IN (
          ARRAY TONUMBER(TRIM(excl)) FOR excl IN SPLIT(d.exclusions, ",") END
        )
),
extra_ingredients AS (
  SELECT TONUMBER(TRIM(extra_id)) AS topping_id
  FROM delivered_orders AS d
  UNNEST SPLIT(d.extras, ",") AS extra_id
  WHERE d.extras IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT pt.topping_name AS ingredient_name, COUNT(1) AS quantity
FROM (
  SELECT topping_id FROM base_ingredients
  UNION ALL
  SELECT topping_id FROM extra_ingredients
) AS i
JOIN `modern_data`.`modern_data_scope`.`pizza_toppings` AS pt
  ON i.topping_id = pt.topping_id
GROUP BY pt.topping_name
ORDER BY quantity DESC, ingredient_name;

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        CONCAT(SUBSTR(MIN(ct.txn_date), 0, 7), '-01') AS min_month,
        CONCAT(SUBSTR(MAX(ct.txn_date), 0, 7), '-01') AS max_month
    FROM `bank_sales_trading`.`bank_sales_trading_scope`.`customer_transactions` AS ct
),
month_series AS (
    SELECT DATE_ADD_STR(b.min_month, idx, "month") AS month_start
    FROM bounds AS b
    UNNEST ARRAY_RANGE(0, DATE_DIFF_STR(b.max_month, b.min_month, "month") + 1) AS idx
),
customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ct.customer_id
    FROM `bank_sales_trading`.`bank_sales_trading_scope`.`customer_transactions` AS ct
),
monthly_net AS (
    SELECT
        ct.customer_id,
        CONCAT(SUBSTR(ct.txn_date, 0, 7), '-01') AS month_start,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN LOWER(ct.txn_type) = "deposit" THEN ct.txn_amount
                WHEN LOWER(ct.txn_type) IN ["purchase", "withdrawal"] THEN -ct.txn_amount
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS monthly_change
    FROM `bank_sales_trading`.`bank_sales_trading_scope`.`customer_transactions` AS ct
    GROUP BY ct.customer_id, CONCAT(SUBSTR(ct.txn_date, 0, 7), '-01')
),
customer_months AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        m.month_start
    FROM customers AS c
    CROSS JOIN month_series AS m
)
SELECT
    cm.customer_id,
    cm.month_start,
    COALESCE(mn.monthly_change, 0) AS monthly_change,
    SUM(COALESCE(mn.monthly_change, 0)) OVER (
        PARTITION BY cm.customer_id
        ORDER BY cm.month_start
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS closing_balance
FROM customer_months AS cm
LEFT JOIN monthly_net AS mn
    ON cm.customer_id = mn.customer_id
   AND cm.month_start = mn.month_start
ORDER BY cm.customer_id, cm.month_start;

    SUM(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 2 AND pv.visit_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS left_in_cart_without_purchase_count,

WITH peak_per_interest AS (
    SELECT
        imap.interest_name,
        peak.month_year,
        peak.composition
    FROM (
        SELECT
            m.interest_id,
            ARRAY_AGG(
                {
                    "month_year": m.month_year,
                    "composition": m.composition
                }
                ORDER BY m.composition DESC, m.month_year DESC
            )[0] AS peak
        FROM `bank_sales_trading`.`bank_sales_trading_scope`.`interest_metrics` AS m
        WHERE m.interest_id IS NOT NULL
          AND m.month_year IS NOT NULL
          AND m.composition IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY m.interest_id
    ) AS p
    JOIN `bank_sales_trading`.`bank_sales_trading_scope`.`interest_map` AS imap
        ON p.interest_id = imap.id
),
top10 AS (
    SELECT
        "Top 10" AS category_group,
        month_year,
        interest_name,
        composition
    FROM peak_per_interest
    ORDER BY composition DESC, interest_name
    LIMIT 10
),
bottom10 AS (
    SELECT
        "Bottom 10" AS category_group,
        month_year,
        interest_name,
        composition
    FROM peak_per_interest
    ORDER BY composition ASC, interest_name
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT category_group, month_year, interest_name, composition
FROM top10
UNION ALL
SELECT category_group, month_year, interest_name, composition
FROM bottom10
ORDER BY category_group, composition DESC, interest_name;

    SELECT
        st.StudLastName AS last_name,
        ss.StudentID,
        ss.ClassID,
        ss.Grade
    FROM `school_scheduling`.`school_scheduling_scope`.`Student_Schedules` AS ss
    JOIN `school_scheduling`.`school_scheduling_scope`.`Students` AS st
        ON ss.StudentID = st.StudentID
    JOIN `school_scheduling`.`school_scheduling_scope`.`Classes` AS c
        ON ss.ClassID = c.ClassID
    JOIN `school_scheduling`.`school_scheduling_scope`.`Subjects` AS sub
        ON c.SubjectID = sub.SubjectID
    WHERE ss.ClassStatus = 2
      AND sub.CategoryID = "ENG"
),
total_completed AS (
    SELECT COUNT(1) AS total_count
    FROM completed_english
)
SELECT
    ce.last_name,
    CASE
        WHEN (ranked.rank_position / tc.total_count) <= 0.20 THEN "First"
        WHEN (ranked.rank_position / tc.total_count) <= 0.40 THEN "Second"
        WHEN (ranked.rank_position / tc.total_count) <= 0.60 THEN "Third"
        WHEN (ranked.rank_position / tc.total_count) <= 0.80 THEN "Fourth"
        ELSE "Fifth"
    END AS quintile
FROM completed_english AS ce
CROSS JOIN total_completed AS tc
JOIN (
    SELECT
        ce1.StudentID,
        ce1.ClassID,
        ce1.Grade,
        COUNT(1) AS rank_position
    FROM completed_english AS ce1
    JOIN completed_english AS ce2

        WHEN (ranked.rank_position / tc.total_count) <= 0.60 THEN 3
        WHEN (ranked.rank_position / tc.total_count) <= 0.80 THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END,
    ce.Grade DESC,
    ce.last_name;

        n.name AS director_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS movie_count,
        ARRAY_AGG(m.date_published ORDER BY m.date_published) AS published_dates,
        ROUND(AVG(r.avg_rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
        SUM(r.total_votes) AS total_votes,
        MIN(r.avg_rating) AS min_rating,
        MAX(r.avg_rating) AS max_rating,
        SUM(m.duration) AS total_movie_duration
    FROM `imdb_movies`.`imdb_movies_scope`.`director_mapping` AS dm
    JOIN `imdb_movies`.`imdb_movies_scope`.`names` AS n
        ON dm.name_id = n.id
    JOIN `imdb_movies`.`imdb_movies_scope`.`movies` AS m
        ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    LEFT JOIN `imdb_movies`.`imdb_movies_scope`.`ratings` AS r
        ON m.id = r.movie_id
    GROUP BY n.id, n.name
)
SELECT
    ds.director_id AS id,
    ds.director_name AS name,
    ds.movie_count,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(ds.published_dates) > 1 THEN ARRAY_AVG(
                ARRAY DATE_DIFF_STR(ds.published_dates[i], ds.published_dates[i - 1], "day")

            ELSE NULL
        END,
        0
    ) AS avg_inter_movie_duration,
    ds.avg_rating,
    ds.total_votes,
    ds.min_rating,
    ds.max_rating,
    ds.total_movie_duration
FROM director_stats AS ds
ORDER BY ds.movie_count DESC, ds.total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9;

WITH annual_region_purchase AS (
    SELECT
        m.region AS region,
        TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 7, 4)) AS txn_year,
        SUM(t.quantity * p.price) AS total_dollar_spent,
        SUM(t.quantity) AS total_quantity_purchased,
        SUM(t.quantity * p.price) / NULLIF(SUM(t.quantity), 0) AS avg_purchase_price_per_bitcoin
    FROM `bank_sales_trading`.`bank_sales_trading_scope`.`bitcoin_transactions` AS t
    JOIN `bank_sales_trading`.`bank_sales_trading_scope`.`bitcoin_members` AS m
        ON t.member_id = m.member_id
    JOIN `bank_sales_trading`.`bank_sales_trading_scope`.`bitcoin_prices` AS p
        ON p.ticker = t.ticker
       AND p.market_date = t.txn_date
    WHERE t.txn_type = "BUY"
      AND t.ticker = "BTC"
    GROUP BY m.region, TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 7, 4))
),
region_year_stats AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        txn_year,
        total_dollar_spent,
        total_quantity_purchased,
        avg_purchase_price_per_bitcoin,
        MIN(txn_year) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS first_txn_year,
        LAG(avg_purchase_price_per_bitcoin) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year) AS prev_year_avg_price
    FROM annual_region_purchase
)
SELECT
    region,
    txn_year AS year,
    total_dollar_spent,
    total_quantity_purchased,
    avg_purchase_price_per_bitcoin,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_year ORDER BY avg_purchase_price_per_bitcoin DESC) AS region_rank,
    ROUND(((avg_purchase_price_per_bitcoin - prev_year_avg_price) / NULLIF(prev_year_avg_price, 0)) * 100, 2) AS annual_pct_change_in_cost
FROM region_year_stats
WHERE txn_year > first_txn_year
ORDER BY year, region_rank, region;

qualifying_legislators AS (

)
SELECT

GROUP BY ft.first_state

query:
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        i.film_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS total_film_revenue
    FROM `sqlite-sakila`.`sqlite_sakila_scope`.`payment` AS p
    JOIN `sqlite-sakila`.`sqlite_sakila_scope`.`rental` AS r
        ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN `sqlite-sakila`.`sqlite_sakila_scope`.`inventory` AS i
        ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    GROUP BY i.film_id
),
film_actor_counts AS (
    SELECT
        fa.film_id,
        COUNT(*) AS actor_count
    FROM `sqlite-sakila`.`sqlite_sakila_scope`.`film_actor` AS fa
    GROUP BY fa.film_id
),
actor_film_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        a.actor_id,
        a.first_name,
        a.last_name,
        f.film_id,
        f.title,
        fr.total_film_revenue / fac.actor_count AS revenue_per_actor
    FROM `sqlite-sakila`.`sqlite_sakila_scope`.`actor` AS a
    JOIN `sqlite-sakila`.`sqlite_sakila_scope`.`film_actor` AS fa
        ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
    JOIN `sqlite-sakila`.`sqlite_sakila_scope`.`film` AS f
        ON fa.film_id = f.film_id
    JOIN film_revenue AS fr
        ON fa.film_id = fr.film_id
    JOIN film_actor_counts AS fac
        ON fa.film_id = fac.film_id
),
ranked_films AS (
    SELECT
        afr.actor_id,
        afr.first_name,
        afr.last_name,
        afr.film_id,
        afr.title,
        afr.revenue_per_actor,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY afr.actor_id
            ORDER BY afr.revenue_per_actor DESC, afr.title
        ) AS film_rank
    FROM actor_film_revenue AS afr
)
SELECT
    rf.actor_id,
    rf.first_name,
    rf.last_name,
    rf.film_id,
    rf.title,
    rf.revenue_per_actor,
    AVG(rf.revenue_per_actor) OVER (PARTITION BY rf.actor_id) AS avg_revenue_per_actor_in_top_films,
    rf.film_rank
FROM ranked_films AS rf
WHERE rf.film_rank <= 3
ORDER BY rf.actor_id, rf.film_rank;

    a.actor_id,

        r.customer_id,

    SELECT p.customer_id
    FROM `sqlite-sakila`.`sqlite_sakila_scope`.`payment` AS p
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
    ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC
    LIMIT 10

monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT

        DATE_TRUNC_STR(p.payment_date, "month") AS month_start,
        SUM(p.amount) AS monthly_amount
    FROM `sqlite-sakila`.`sqlite_sakila_scope`.`payment` AS p
    JOIN top_customers AS tc
        ON p.customer_id = tc.customer_id
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC_STR(p.payment_date, "month")
),
monthly_changes AS (
    SELECT
        m1.customer_id,
        m1.month_start AS from_month,
        m2.month_start AS to_month,
        ABS(m2.monthly_amount - m1.monthly_amount) AS month_over_month_diff
    FROM monthly_payments AS m1

JOIN `sqlite-sakila`.`sqlite_sakila_scope`.`customer` AS c
    ON mc.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY mc.month_over_month_diff DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH word_signatures AS (
    SELECT
        w.words,
        LENGTH(w.words) AS word_length,
        ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_SORT(SPLIT(w.words, "")), "") AS signature
    FROM `modern_data`.`modern_data_scope`.`word_list` AS w
),
anagram_groups AS (
    SELECT
        signature,
        word_length,
        COUNT(*) AS group_count
    FROM word_signatures
    GROUP BY signature, word_length
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT
    ws.words,
    ag.group_count - 1 AS anagram_count
FROM word_signatures AS ws
JOIN anagram_groups AS ag
    ON ws.signature = ag.signature
   AND ws.word_length = ag.word_length
WHERE ws.word_length BETWEEN 4 AND 5
  AND ws.words LIKE "r%"
ORDER BY ws.words ASC
LIMIT 10;

GROUP BY ts.store_id, ts.store_name, ts.total_orders;

WITH duration_stats AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(t.Milliseconds) AS min_ms,
        AVG(t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ms,
        MAX(t.Milliseconds) AS max_ms
    FROM `music`.`music_scope`.`Track` AS t
),
classified_tracks AS (
    SELECT
        t.TrackId,
        t.Milliseconds,
        CASE
            WHEN t.Milliseconds < ((ds.min_ms + ds.avg_ms) / 2) THEN "Short"
            WHEN t.Milliseconds < ((ds.avg_ms + ds.max_ms) / 2) THEN "Medium"
            ELSE "Long"
        END AS length_type
    FROM `music`.`music_scope`.`Track` AS t
    CROSS JOIN duration_stats AS ds
)
SELECT
    ct.length_type,
    MIN(ct.Milliseconds) / 60000.0 AS min_time_minutes,
    MAX(ct.Milliseconds) / 60000.0 AS max_time_minutes,
    SUM(il.Quantity * il.UnitPrice) AS total_revenue
FROM classified_tracks AS ct
JOIN `music`.`music_scope`.`InvoiceLine` AS il
    ON il.TrackId = ct.TrackId
GROUP BY ct.length_type
ORDER BY CASE ct.length_type
    WHEN "Short" THEN 1
    WHEN "Medium" THEN 2
    ELSE 3
END;

WITH cleaned_salaries AS (
    SELECT
        s.Location,
        s.CompanyName,
        TONUMBER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(s.Salary, "₹", ""), ",", ""), "/yr", "")) AS salary_value
    FROM `education_business`.`education_business_scope`.`SalaryDataset` AS s
    WHERE s.Location IN ["Mumbai", "Pune", "New Delhi", "Hyderabad"]
      AND s.Salary IS NOT NULL
      AND s.CompanyName IS NOT NULL
),
city_company_avg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.Location,
        cs.CompanyName,
        AVG(cs.salary_value) AS avg_salary_in_state
    FROM cleaned_salaries AS cs
    WHERE cs.salary_value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY cs.Location, cs.CompanyName
),
country_company_avg AS (
    SELECT
        s.CompanyName,
        AVG(TONUMBER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(s.Salary, "₹", ""), ",", ""), "/yr", ""))) AS avg_salary_in_country
    FROM `education_business`.`education_business_scope`.`SalaryDataset` AS s
    WHERE s.Salary IS NOT NULL
      AND s.CompanyName IS NOT NULL
      AND TONUMBER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(s.Salary, "₹", ""), ",", ""), "/yr", "")) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.CompanyName
),
ranked_companies AS (
    SELECT
        cca.Location,
        cca.CompanyName,
        cca.avg_salary_in_state,
        cca2.avg_salary_in_country,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cca.Location
            ORDER BY cca.avg_salary_in_state DESC, cca.CompanyName
        ) AS rn
    FROM city_company_avg AS cca
    JOIN country_company_avg AS cca2

)
SELECT
    Location,
    CompanyName AS `Company Name`,
    avg_salary_in_state AS `Average Salary in State`,
    avg_salary_in_country AS `Average Salary in Country`
FROM ranked_companies
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY Location, `Average Salary in State` DESC, `Company Name`;

    SELECT
        b.bowler AS bowler_id,
        b.match_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) AS match_runs_conceded,
        COUNT(1) AS balls_bowled
    FROM `IPL`.`IPL_scope`.`ball_by_ball` AS b
    LEFT JOIN `IPL`.`IPL_scope`.`batsman_scored` AS bs
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id
       AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
       AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
       AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
wickets_match AS (
    SELECT
        b.bowler AS bowler_id,
        w.match_id,
        COUNT(1) AS wickets
    FROM `IPL`.`IPL_scope`.`wicket_taken` AS w
    JOIN `IPL`.`IPL_scope`.`ball_by_ball` AS b
        ON b.match_id = w.match_id
       AND b.innings_no = w.innings_no
       AND b.over_id = w.over_id
       AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id
    WHERE LOWER(w.kind_out) NOT IN ["run out", "retired hurt", "obstructing the field"]
    GROUP BY b.bowler, w.match_id
),
match_perf AS (
    SELECT
        r.bowler_id,
        r.match_id,
        COALESCE(w.wickets, 0) AS wickets,
        r.match_runs_conceded
    FROM bowling_runs AS r
    LEFT JOIN wickets_match AS w
        ON r.bowler_id = w.bowler_id
       AND r.match_id = w.match_id
),
best_match AS (
    SELECT
        m1.bowler_id,
        m1.match_id,
        m1.wickets,
        m1.match_runs_conceded
    FROM match_perf AS m1
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM match_perf AS m2
        WHERE m2.bowler_id = m1.bowler_id
          AND (
                m2.wickets > m1.wickets
                OR (m2.wickets = m1.wickets AND m2.match_runs_conceded < m1.match_runs_conceded)
                OR (m2.wickets = m1.wickets AND m2.match_runs_conceded = m1.match_runs_conceded AND m2.match_id < m1.match_id)
              )
    )
),
career AS (
    SELECT
        r.bowler_id,
        SUM(r.match_runs_conceded) AS total_runs_conceded,
        SUM(r.balls_bowled) AS total_balls_bowled,
        SUM(COALESCE(w.wickets, 0)) AS total_wickets
    FROM bowling_runs AS r
    LEFT JOIN wickets_match AS w
        ON r.bowler_id = w.bowler_id
       AND r.match_id = w.match_id
    GROUP BY r.bowler_id
)
SELECT
    c.bowler_id,
    p.player_name AS bowler_name,
    c.total_wickets AS wickets_taken,
    ROUND((c.total_runs_conceded * 6.0) / NULLIF(c.total_balls_bowled, 0), 2) AS economy_rate,
    ROUND(c.total_balls_bowled / NULLIF(c.total_wickets, 0), 2) AS strike_rate,
    CONCAT(TOSTRING(bm.wickets), "-", TOSTRING(bm.match_runs_conceded)) AS best_bowling
FROM career AS c
LEFT JOIN best_match AS bm
    ON c.bowler_id = bm.bowler_id
LEFT JOIN `IPL`.`IPL_scope`.`player` AS p
    ON c.bowler_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY wickets_taken DESC, economy_rate ASC, strike_rate ASC, c.bowler_id;

WITH `role_stats` AS (
    SELECT
        pm.player_id,
        pm.role,
        COUNT(1) AS role_count
    FROM `IPL`.`IPL_scope`.`player_match` AS pm
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, pm.role
),
`role_pick` AS (
    SELECT
        rs.player_id,
        ARRAY_AGG(rs.role ORDER BY rs.role_count DESC, rs.role ASC)[0] AS most_frequent_role
    FROM `role_stats` AS rs
    GROUP BY rs.player_id
),
`matches_played` AS (
    SELECT
        pm.player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS total_matches_played
    FROM `IPL`.`IPL_scope`.`player_match` AS pm
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
`batting_match` AS (
    SELECT
        bbb.striker AS player_id,
        bbb.match_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) AS match_runs,
        COUNT(1) AS balls_faced
    FROM `IPL`.`IPL_scope`.`ball_by_ball` AS bbb
    LEFT JOIN `IPL`.`IPL_scope`.`batsman_scored` AS bs
        ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id
       AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
       AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id
       AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbb.match_id
),
`batting_career` AS (
    SELECT
        bm.player_id,
        SUM(bm.match_runs) AS total_runs_scored,
        SUM(bm.balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced,
        MAX(bm.match_runs) AS highest_score,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bm.match_runs >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_at_least_30,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bm.match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_at_least_50,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bm.match_runs >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_at_least_100
    FROM `batting_match` AS bm
    GROUP BY bm.player_id
),
`dismissals` AS (
    SELECT
        wt.player_out AS player_id,
        COUNT(1) AS total_dismissals
    FROM `IPL`.`IPL_scope`.`wicket_taken` AS wt
    GROUP BY wt.player_out
),
`bowling_match` AS (
    SELECT
        bbb.bowler AS player_id,
        bbb.match_id,
        COUNT(1) AS balls_bowled,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) AS runs_conceded,
        SUM(CASE WHEN wt.player_out IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_taken
    FROM `IPL`.`IPL_scope`.`ball_by_ball` AS bbb
    LEFT JOIN `IPL`.`IPL_scope`.`batsman_scored` AS bs

       AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
       AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id
       AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN `IPL`.`IPL_scope`.`wicket_taken` AS wt
        ON bbb.match_id = wt.match_id
       AND bbb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
       AND bbb.over_id = wt.over_id
       AND bbb.ball_id = wt.ball_id
    GROUP BY bbb.bowler, bbb.match_id
),
`bowling_career` AS (
    SELECT
        bm.player_id,
        SUM(bm.wickets_taken) AS total_wickets_taken,
        SUM(bm.runs_conceded) AS total_runs_conceded,
        SUM(bm.balls_bowled) AS total_balls_bowled
    FROM `bowling_match` AS bm
    GROUP BY bm.player_id
),
`best_bowling` AS (
    SELECT
        bm.player_id,
        ARRAY_AGG(
            TO_STRING(bm.wickets_taken) || "-" || TO_STRING(bm.runs_conceded)
            ORDER BY bm.wickets_taken DESC, bm.runs_conceded ASC, bm.match_id ASC
        )[0] AS best_bowling_performance
    FROM `bowling_match` AS bm
    GROUP BY bm.player_id
)
SELECT
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    rp.most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(bc.total_runs_scored, 0) AS total_runs_scored,
    COALESCE(mp.total_matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
    COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_times_dismissed,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) = 0 THEN NULL

    COALESCE(bc.matches_at_least_50, 0) AS matches_with_at_least_50_runs,
    COALESCE(bc.matches_at_least_100, 0) AS matches_with_at_least_100_runs,
    COALESCE(bc.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(bc.total_balls_faced, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND((COALESCE(bc.total_runs_scored, 0) * 100.0) / bc.total_balls_faced, 2)
    END AS strike_rate,
    COALESCE(bowlc.total_wickets_taken, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(bowlc.total_balls_bowled, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND((COALESCE(bowlc.total_runs_conceded, 0) * 6.0) / bowlc.total_balls_bowled, 2)
    END AS economy_rate,
    COALESCE(bb.best_bowling_performance, "0-0") AS best_bowling_performance
FROM `IPL`.`IPL_scope`.`player` AS p
LEFT JOIN `role_pick` AS rp
    ON p.player_id = rp.player_id
LEFT JOIN `matches_played` AS mp

LEFT JOIN `batting_career` AS bc

LEFT JOIN `dismissals` AS d

LEFT JOIN `bowling_career` AS bowlc
    ON p.player_id = bowlc.player_id
LEFT JOIN `best_bowling` AS bb
    ON p.player_id = bb.player_id
ORDER BY p.player_id;

WITH step_status AS (
    SELECT
        ms.name,
        ms.version,
        ms.step,
        MAX(CASE WHEN ms.model = 'Stack' THEN ms.test_score ELSE NULL END) AS stack_score,
        MAX(CASE WHEN ms.model != 'Stack' THEN ms.test_score ELSE NULL END) AS max_non_stack
    FROM `stacking`.`stacking_scope`.`model_score` AS ms
    GROUP BY ms.name, ms.version, ms.step
),
l1_status_counts AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN ss.max_non_stack < ss.stack_score THEN 'strong'
            WHEN ss.max_non_stack = ss.stack_score THEN 'soft'
        END AS status,
        m.L1_model,
        COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count
    FROM step_status AS ss
    JOIN `stacking`.`stacking_scope`.`model` AS m
        ON m.name = ss.name
       AND m.version = ss.version
       AND m.step = ss.step
    WHERE ss.stack_score IS NOT NULL
      AND ss.max_non_stack IS NOT NULL
      AND (ss.max_non_stack < ss.stack_score OR ss.max_non_stack = ss.stack_score)
    GROUP BY
        CASE
            WHEN ss.max_non_stack < ss.stack_score THEN 'strong'
            WHEN ss.max_non_stack = ss.stack_score THEN 'soft'
        END,
        m.L1_model
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        c.status,
        c.L1_model,
        c.occurrence_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.status ORDER BY c.occurrence_count DESC, c.L1_model) AS rnk
    FROM l1_status_counts AS c
)
SELECT
    status,
    L1_model,
    occurrence_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY status, L1_model;

WITH inv AS (
    SELECT
        i.product_id,
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        i.qty AS inv_qty,
        p.purchased,
        SUM(i.qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.product_id
            ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty, i.id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) - i.qty AS inv_start_qty,
        SUM(i.qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.product_id
            ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty, i.id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS inv_end_qty
    FROM `oracle_sql`.`oracle_sql_scope`.`inventory` AS i
    JOIN `oracle_sql`.`oracle_sql_scope`.`purchases` AS p
        ON i.purchase_id = p.id
),
ord AS (
    SELECT
        ol.product_id,
        ol.id AS orderline_id,
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty AS ord_qty,
        SUM(ol.qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ol.product_id
            ORDER BY ol.order_id, ol.id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) - ol.qty AS ord_start_qty,
        SUM(ol.qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ol.product_id
            ORDER BY ol.order_id, ol.id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS ord_end_qty
    FROM `oracle_sql`.`oracle_sql_scope`.`orderlines` AS ol
),
alloc AS (
    SELECT
        o.product_id,
        o.orderline_id,
        o.ord_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN LEAST(o.ord_end_qty, i.inv_end_qty) > GREATEST(o.ord_start_qty, i.inv_start_qty)
            THEN LEAST(o.ord_end_qty, i.inv_end_qty) - GREATEST(o.ord_start_qty, i.inv_start_qty)
            ELSE 0
        END AS picked_qty
    FROM ord AS o
    JOIN inv AS i
        ON o.product_id = i.product_id
),
orderline_pick AS (
    SELECT
        a.product_id,
        a.orderline_id,
        MAX(a.ord_qty) AS ord_qty,
        SUM(a.picked_qty) AS total_picked_qty
    FROM alloc AS a
    GROUP BY a.product_id, a.orderline_id
)
SELECT
    p.name AS product_name,
    AVG(CASE WHEN op.ord_qty > 0 THEN (op.total_picked_qty * 100.0) / op.ord_qty ELSE NULL END) AS avg_pick_percentage
FROM orderline_pick AS op
JOIN `oracle_sql`.`oracle_sql_scope`.`products` AS p
    ON op.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY p.name;

WITH RECURSIVE base_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        pm.product_id,
        pm.qty_minimum,
        pm.qty_purchase,
        COALESCE((
            SELECT RAW SUM(p.qty)
            FROM `oracle_sql`.`oracle_sql_scope`.`purchases` AS p
            WHERE p.product_id = pm.product_id
              AND p.purchased < "2019-01-01"
        )[0], 0) -
        COALESCE((
            SELECT RAW SUM(ms.qty)
            FROM `oracle_sql`.`oracle_sql_scope`.`monthly_sales` AS ms
            WHERE ms.product_id = pm.product_id
              AND ms.mth < "2019-01-01"
        )[0], 0) AS start_inventory
    FROM `oracle_sql`.`oracle_sql_scope`.`product_minimums` AS pm
),
inv AS (
    SELECT
        b.product_id,
        b.qty_minimum,
        b.qty_purchase,
        "2019-01-01" AS mth,
        b.start_inventory AS beginning_inventory,
        CASE
            WHEN b.start_inventory - COALESCE((
                SELECT RAW SUM(ms.qty)
                FROM `oracle_sql`.`oracle_sql_scope`.`monthly_sales` AS ms
                WHERE ms.product_id = b.product_id
                  AND ms.mth = "2019-01-01"
            )[0], 0) < b.qty_minimum
            THEN b.start_inventory - COALESCE((
                SELECT RAW SUM(ms.qty)
                FROM `oracle_sql`.`oracle_sql_scope`.`monthly_sales` AS ms
                WHERE ms.product_id = b.product_id
                  AND ms.mth = "2019-01-01"
            )[0], 0) + b.qty_purchase
            ELSE b.start_inventory - COALESCE((
                SELECT RAW SUM(ms.qty)
                FROM `oracle_sql`.`oracle_sql_scope`.`monthly_sales` AS ms
                WHERE ms.product_id = b.product_id
                  AND ms.mth = "2019-01-01"
            )[0], 0)
        END AS ending_inventory
    FROM base_inventory AS b

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        i.product_id,
        i.qty_minimum,
        i.qty_purchase,
        DATE_ADD_STR(i.mth, 1, "month") AS mth,
        i.ending_inventory AS beginning_inventory,
        CASE
            WHEN i.ending_inventory - COALESCE((
                SELECT RAW SUM(ms.qty)
                FROM `oracle_sql`.`oracle_sql_scope`.`monthly_sales` AS ms
                WHERE ms.product_id = i.product_id
                  AND ms.mth = DATE_ADD_STR(i.mth, 1, "month")
            )[0], 0) < i.qty_minimum
            THEN i.ending_inventory - COALESCE((
                SELECT RAW SUM(ms.qty)
                FROM `oracle_sql`.`oracle_sql_scope`.`monthly_sales` AS ms
                WHERE ms.product_id = i.product_id
                  AND ms.mth = DATE_ADD_STR(i.mth, 1, "month")
            )[0], 0) + i.qty_purchase
            ELSE i.ending_inventory - COALESCE((
                SELECT RAW SUM(ms.qty)
                FROM `oracle_sql`.`oracle_sql_scope`.`monthly_sales` AS ms
                WHERE ms.product_id = i.product_id
                  AND ms.mth = DATE_ADD_STR(i.mth, 1, "month")
            )[0], 0)
        END AS ending_inventory
    FROM inv AS i
    WHERE i.mth < "2019-12-01"
),
diffs AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        mth,
        ABS(ending_inventory - qty_minimum) AS abs_diff
    FROM inv
)
SELECT
    d.product_id,
    MIN(d.mth) AS mth,
    m.min_abs_diff AS abs_diff
FROM diffs AS d
JOIN (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        MIN(abs_diff) AS min_abs_diff
    FROM diffs
    GROUP BY product_id
) AS m
    ON d.product_id = m.product_id
   AND d.abs_diff = m.min_abs_diff
GROUP BY d.product_id, m.min_abs_diff
ORDER BY d.product_id;

WITH team_points AS (
    SELECT
        m.season,
        m.league_id,
        m.country_id,
        m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS points
    FROM `EU_soccer`.`EU_soccer_scope`.`Match` AS m
    GROUP BY m.season, m.league_id, m.country_id, m.home_team_api_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        m.season,
        m.league_id,
        m.country_id,
        m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS points
    FROM `EU_soccer`.`EU_soccer_scope`.`Match` AS m
    GROUP BY m.season, m.league_id, m.country_id, m.away_team_api_id
),
season_team_points AS (
    SELECT
        tp.season,
        tp.league_id,
        tp.country_id,
        tp.team_api_id,
        SUM(tp.points) AS total_points
    FROM team_points AS tp
    GROUP BY tp.season, tp.league_id, tp.country_id, tp.team_api_id
),
league_season_max AS (
    SELECT
        stp.season,
        stp.league_id,
        stp.country_id,
        MAX(stp.total_points) AS max_points
    FROM season_team_points AS stp
    GROUP BY stp.season, stp.league_id, stp.country_id
)
SELECT
    stp.season,
    t.team_long_name AS champion_team,
    l.name AS league,
    c.name AS country,
    stp.total_points
FROM season_team_points AS stp
JOIN league_season_max AS lm
    ON stp.season = lm.season
   AND stp.league_id = lm.league_id
   AND stp.country_id = lm.country_id
   AND stp.total_points = lm.max_points
JOIN `EU_soccer`.`EU_soccer_scope`.`Team` AS t
    ON stp.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN `EU_soccer`.`EU_soccer_scope`.`League` AS l
    ON stp.league_id = l.id
JOIN `EU_soccer`.`EU_soccer_scope`.`Country` AS c
    ON stp.country_id = c.id
ORDER BY stp.season, country, league, champion_team;

WITH seller_item_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(1) AS products_sold_qty,
        SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) AS avg_item_price,
        AVG(orv.review_score) AS avg_review_score,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
                     AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
                THEN (STR_TO_MILLIS(o.order_delivered_carrier_date) - STR_TO_MILLIS(o.order_approved_at)) / 3600000.0
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) AS avg_packing_time_hours
    FROM `electronic_sales`.`electronic_sales_scope`.`order_items` AS oi
    JOIN `electronic_sales`.`electronic_sales_scope`.`orders` AS o
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN `electronic_sales`.`electronic_sales_scope`.`order_reviews` AS orv
        ON oi.order_id = orv.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(1) > 100
),
seller_category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        oi.seller_id,
        COALESCE(pcnt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'Unknown') AS top_category_name_english,
        COUNT(1) AS category_sales_volume,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY oi.seller_id
            ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC, COALESCE(pcnt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'Unknown')
        ) AS rn
    FROM `electronic_sales`.`electronic_sales_scope`.`order_items` AS oi
    JOIN `electronic_sales`.`electronic_sales_scope`.`products` AS p
        ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN `electronic_sales`.`electronic_sales_scope`.`product_category_name_translation` AS pcnt
        ON p.product_category_name = pcnt.product_category_name
    GROUP BY
        oi.seller_id,
        COALESCE(pcnt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'Unknown')
)

    s.seller_state,

  SELECT
    t.customer_id,
    CONCAT(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 0, 7), '-01') AS month_start,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN LOWER(t.txn_type) = 'deposit' THEN t.txn_amount
          WHEN LOWER(t.txn_type) = 'withdrawal' THEN -t.txn_amount
          ELSE 0
        END) AS monthly_net
  FROM `bank_sales_trading`.`bank_sales_trading_scope`.`customer_transactions` AS t
  WHERE LOWER(t.txn_type) IN ['deposit', 'withdrawal']
  GROUP BY t.customer_id, CONCAT(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 0, 7), '-01')
),
balances AS (
  SELECT
    m.customer_id,
    m.month_start,
    m.monthly_net,
    SUM(m.monthly_net) OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.customer_id
      ORDER BY m.month_start
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS closing_balance
  FROM monthly_nets AS m
),
recent_growth AS (
  SELECT
    b.customer_id,
    b.month_start,
    b.closing_balance,
    LAG(b.closing_balance) OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.customer_id
      ORDER BY b.month_start
    ) AS prior_closing_balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.customer_id
      ORDER BY b.month_start DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM balances AS b
)
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN (
        CASE
          WHEN COALESCE(prior_closing_balance, 0) = 0 THEN closing_balance * 100.0
          ELSE ((closing_balance - prior_closing_balance) / prior_closing_balance) * 100.0
        END
      ) > 5 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_of_customers
FROM recent_growth
WHERE rn = 1;

final_races AS (

    FROM all_races AS r
    JOIN (
        SELECT year, MAX(round) AS max_round
        FROM all_races
        GROUP BY year
    ) AS mr
        ON r.year = mr.year
       AND r.round = mr.max_round
),
all_driver_standings AS (
    SELECT driver_id, race_id, points
    FROM `f1`.`f1_scope`.`driver_standings`
    UNION ALL
    SELECT driver_id, race_id, points
    FROM `f1`.`f1_scope`.`driver_standings_ext`
),
constructor_names AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, name
    FROM `f1`.`f1_scope`.`constructors`
    UNION ALL
    SELECT constructor_id, name
    FROM `f1`.`f1_scope`.`constructors_ext`
),
best_driver_by_constructor_year AS (
    SELECT
        fr.year,
        res.constructor_id,
        MAX(ds.points) AS best_driver_points
    FROM final_races AS fr
    JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`results` AS res
        ON res.race_id = fr.race_id
    JOIN all_driver_standings AS ds
        ON ds.race_id = fr.race_id
       AND ds.driver_id = res.driver_id
    GROUP BY fr.year, res.constructor_id
),
team_points_by_constructor_year AS (
    SELECT
        fr.year,
        cs.constructor_id,
        cs.points AS team_points
    FROM final_races AS fr
    JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`constructor_standings` AS cs
        ON cs.race_id = fr.race_id

    bd.best_driver_points + tp.team_points AS combined_points
FROM team_points_by_constructor_year AS tp
JOIN best_driver_by_constructor_year AS bd
    ON tp.year = bd.year
   AND tp.constructor_id = bd.constructor_id
LEFT JOIN constructor_names AS cn
    ON tp.constructor_id = cn.constructor_id

SELECT
  seq.third_page AS third_page_visit,
  COUNT(1) AS occurrence_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    a.session,
    a.stamp,
    a.path AS first_page,
    LEAD(a.path, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.session ORDER BY a.stamp) AS second_page,
    LEAD(a.path, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY a.session ORDER BY a.stamp) AS third_page
  FROM `log`.`log_scope`.`activity_log` AS a
) AS seq
WHERE seq.first_page = '/detail'
  AND seq.second_page = '/detail'
  AND seq.third_page IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY seq.third_page
ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC, third_page_visit
LIMIT 3;

WITH overtakes AS (
    SELECT
        c1.race_id,
        c1.lap,
        c1.driver_id AS overtaker_id,
        c2.driver_id AS overtaken_id
    FROM `f1`.`f1_scope`.`lap_positions` AS c1
    JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`lap_positions` AS c2
        ON c1.race_id = c2.race_id
       AND c1.lap = c2.lap
       AND c1.lap_type = "Race"
       AND c2.lap_type = "Race"
       AND c1.driver_id != c2.driver_id
       AND c1.position < c2.position
    JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`lap_positions` AS p1
        ON p1.race_id = c1.race_id
       AND p1.lap = c1.lap - 1
       AND p1.lap_type = "Race"
       AND p1.driver_id = c1.driver_id
    JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`lap_positions` AS p2
        ON p2.race_id = c2.race_id
       AND p2.lap = c2.lap - 1
       AND p2.lap_type = "Race"
       AND p2.driver_id = c2.driver_id
    JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`races_ext` AS rx
        ON rx.race_id = c1.race_id
       AND rx.is_pit_data_available = 1
    WHERE c1.lap > 1
      AND p1.position > p2.position

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        c1.race_id,
        c1.lap,
        c1.driver_id AS overtaker_id,
        c2.driver_id AS overtaken_id
    FROM `f1`.`f1_scope`.`lap_positions` AS c1
    JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`lap_positions` AS c2
        ON c1.race_id = c2.race_id
       AND c1.lap = c2.lap
       AND c1.lap = 1
       AND c1.lap_type = "Race"
       AND c2.lap_type = "Race"
       AND c1.driver_id != c2.driver_id
       AND c1.position < c2.position
    JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`results` AS r1
        ON r1.race_id = c1.race_id
       AND r1.driver_id = c1.driver_id
    JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`results` AS r2
        ON r2.race_id = c2.race_id
       AND r2.driver_id = c2.driver_id
    JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`races_ext` AS rx
        ON rx.race_id = c1.race_id
       AND rx.is_pit_data_available = 1
    WHERE r1.grid > 0
      AND r2.grid > 0
      AND r1.grid > r2.grid
      AND ABS(r1.grid - r2.grid) <= 2
),
classified AS (
    SELECT
        o.race_id,
        o.lap,
        o.overtaker_id,
        o.overtaken_id,
        CASE
            WHEN ret.driver_id IS NOT NULL THEN "R"
            WHEN ps_same.driver_id IS NOT NULL THEN "P"
            WHEN ps_prev.driver_id IS NOT NULL
                 AND lto.running_milliseconds IS NOT NULL
                 AND ltt.running_milliseconds IS NOT NULL
                 AND ABS(lto.running_milliseconds - ltt.running_milliseconds) < 30000 THEN "P"
            WHEN o.lap = 1 THEN "S"
            ELSE "T"
        END AS overtake_type
    FROM overtakes AS o
    LEFT JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`retirements` AS ret
        ON ret.race_id = o.race_id
       AND ret.driver_id = o.overtaken_id
       AND ret.lap = o.lap
    LEFT JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`pit_stops` AS ps_same
        ON ps_same.race_id = o.race_id
       AND ps_same.driver_id = o.overtaken_id
       AND ps_same.lap = o.lap
    LEFT JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`pit_stops` AS ps_prev
        ON ps_prev.race_id = o.race_id
       AND ps_prev.driver_id = o.overtaken_id
       AND ps_prev.lap = o.lap - 1
    LEFT JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`lap_times_ext` AS lto
        ON lto.race_id = o.race_id
       AND lto.driver_id = o.overtaken_id
       AND lto.lap = o.lap
    LEFT JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`lap_times_ext` AS ltt
        ON ltt.race_id = o.race_id
       AND ltt.driver_id = o.overtaker_id
       AND ltt.lap = o.lap
)

SELECT
  AVG(g.first_missed_round) AS avg_first_round_missed,
  AVG(g.last_missed_round) AS avg_last_round_missed
FROM (
  SELECT
    d1.driver_id,
    d1.year,
    d1.last_round + 1 AS first_missed_round,
    d2.first_round - 1 AS last_missed_round
  FROM `f1`.`f1_scope`.`drives` AS d1
  JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`drives` AS d2
    ON d2.driver_id = d1.driver_id
   AND d2.year = d1.year
   AND d2.first_round = (
     SELECT RAW MIN(d3.first_round)
     FROM `f1`.`f1_scope`.`drives` AS d3
     WHERE d3.driver_id = d1.driver_id
       AND d3.year = d1.year
       AND d3.first_round > d1.last_round
   )[0]
  WHERE d2.first_round - d1.last_round - 1 > 0
    AND d2.first_round - d1.last_round - 1 < 3
    AND d1.constructor_id <> d2.constructor_id

WITH race_lap_changes AS (
    SELECT
        curr.race_id,
        curr.driver_id,
        curr.lap AS lap,
        prev.position AS prev_position,
        curr.position AS curr_position,
        prev.position - curr.position AS positions_gained
    FROM `f1`.`f1_scope`.`lap_positions` AS prev
    JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`lap_positions` AS curr
        ON curr.race_id = prev.race_id
       AND curr.driver_id = prev.driver_id

      AND curr.lap_type = "Race"
      AND curr.lap > 1
),
filtered_changes AS (

    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM `f1`.`f1_scope`.`pit_stops` AS p
        WHERE p.race_id = c.race_id
          AND p.driver_id = c.driver_id
          AND p.lap IN [c.lap, c.lap - 1]
    )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM `f1`.`f1_scope`.`retirements` AS r
        WHERE r.race_id = c.race_id
          AND r.driver_id = c.driver_id
          AND r.lap = c.lap
    )
),
driver_overtake_totals AS (
    SELECT
        driver_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN positions_gained > 0 THEN positions_gained ELSE 0 END) AS overtakes_made,
        SUM(CASE WHEN positions_gained < 0 THEN -positions_gained ELSE 0 END) AS times_overtaken
    FROM filtered_changes
    GROUP BY driver_id
)

FROM driver_overtake_totals AS t
JOIN `f1`.`f1_scope`.`drivers` AS d
    ON d.driver_id = t.driver_id
WHERE t.times_overtaken > t.overtakes_made
ORDER BY d.full_name;
